_note: 2_B — the Darby Harrington boss fight, the actual Chapter 2 boss (recon: docs/re-notes/ch2/2_B-darby-boss-fight.md): chained from 2_09's win (the gateway), in the boxing gym (area 27). Darby's opening chase plays on the real _2_B_DARBY_FLEE path to his rest point (the original SKIPS it on restart via IsMissionFromRestart — VERIFIED; our retry:"stage" never replays it either), the two posted prep pairs fight, the ring intro is a letterbox speech exchange, and the boss fight is Darby (hits_to_beat 6 standing in for 300 HP with the x0.2 damage-taken multipliers; boss_bar) plus one summoned pair from the door spawn points — win requires Darby AND his summons down, matching the original's 'Darby HP <= 0 with no preps alive'. STUBBED GAPS (the wave's named deep systems, documented per the recon's gap table): boss_rest_cycle (the 5 s-after-each-wave retreat/vault/return cadence, HP phase maxima), summon_wave_from_doors (continuous 2-at-a-time summons with the no-repeat model rule and the immortal first pair), door_barricade_prop (bracing the two DRBrace doors to cut the spawns — with one fixed summon pair there is nothing to brace), projectile_dodge_window + the bar bottle throws, the health pickups (50%/forced-100%-under-40%), and the doors-lock choreography. Biff lies KO'd ringside in the original — ours is a standing invulnerable color NPC (no lying pose in the stand-in set). The boxing outfit backup/swap, weapon snapshot, and punishment-off are skipped (those systems are pending). The pass chains into Chapt2Trans via mission on_complete start_mission (mirrors 1_B -> Chapt1Trans). Pass side effects live in the campaign row (chapter_set 3 + level-2 force-completes + preppies 100 + yearbook_darby — SMissPass VERIFIED). title: Boxing Challenge: Darby

stages.objective: Darby runs his mouth — and runs.

on_start.sub: The real champion of Bullworth Vale.

on_start.speaker: DARBY
on_start.text: The gym rat who beat my champion. Come — let me show you how a HARRINGTON fights.

stages._retry_note: the original skips this chase on restart (IsMissionFromRestart, VERIFIED) — our retry:stage never replays it anyway

stages.objective: Darby's posted guards want a word.

lines.speaker: DARBY
lines.text: Boys, boys — sit this one out. Watch a gentleman work.

lines.speaker: DARBY
lines.text: You embarrassed my club, Hopkins. That simply isn't done.

on_start.speaker: DARBY
on_start.text: Boys! Softening him up — then I finish him personally.

lines.speaker: JIMMY
lines.text: It is. The Vale just learned winter's over.
